item.title: [IGNITE-2943] .NET: Fix cache store error propagation
item.description: Make sure that exceptions in any ICacheStore methods are propagated to the user code properly.

status.description: The issue is considered finished, the resolution is correct. Issues which are not closed can be reopened.

wip

• Used PlatformNativeException to propagate error
  • Sync/async tests added
  • sessionEnd causes cache breakage: IGNITE-2955

Pavel,

Fix looks too heavy to me. We should not degrade performance of normal operations to propagate error. E.g. {{void put(K, V)} definitely should not require creation of both in and out streams in normal case.

We need to think about less intrusive solution to the problem.

Vladimir.

You are right, there is a 20% performance drop in Apache.Ignite.Benchmarks put/get.

We can reuse input stream in DoOutInOp to eliminate this overhead.

  • Put: unaffected
  • Get: +10%
  • GetAsync: 5% (because null result is indicated by return code now)

Pavel,

It looks like CPP is broken after this change, isn't it? I move it to 1.7 as it is too dangerous for release.
Looks like you've reviewed old PR606, please see new PR672.

Pavel,

I believe we should merge IGNITE-1433 to master first, and then apply changes with stack traces here.

Vladimir.

Github user ptupitsyn closed the pull request at:

https://github.com/apache/ignite/pull/606

Pavel, I am OK with patch, but:
1) Please fix styling issues in Java - missing blank lines between code lines in multiple places.
2) Confirm that there are not regressions in CPP suites.

Once p.1 and p.2 are done, patch can be merged safely.

Igor, can you please help with C++ part?
I've changed the way we pass data between platform and Java for cache operations, now single memory chunk is used for both input and output.

You can checkout PR672 to get my changes.
